name: The Rolling Pumpkin
source:
Once upon a time there was an old woman who had three daughters. All of the three had married and left her house. So she lived alone. One day she was so bored of loneliness that she told herself: "Since my youngest daughter has married my house has gotten so dim and silent. I better go and pay her a visit." 

[From[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909203131/http://www.renai.us/game/pumpkin.shtml] Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
从前，有一位老妇人，她有三个女儿。三人都已结婚并离开了她的家。所以她一个人住。有一天，她厌倦了孤独，她告诉自己：“自从我的小女儿结婚以来，我的房子变得如此昏暗和寂静，我最好去看看她。” 

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909203131/http://www.renai.us/game/pumpkin.shtml]仁爱档案[/url]]
